lines.japanese:
秋葉の事を琥珀さんに任せて、一階におりてきた。
　俺には秋葉の手当てをする事はできない。
　だから何か別のことで、秋葉の力になってやりたかった。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
Leaving Akiha in Kohaku’s care, I go downstairs.
I can’t treat Akiha’s injuries myself.
I want to help her somehow, even if it has to be in some other way.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirror_moon:

　なにしろ遠野家の当主だったんだ。
　遠野の血とやらの対処法も少しは記録しているだろう。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
There might be something in Father’s room that could help her.
He had been head of the Tohno family, after all.
Surely he had left at least some record of how to deal with this Tohno blood of ours.

lines.mirror_moon:

「くそ―――さすがに都合よくは見付からないか」
　はあ、と息をついて椅子に座る。
　親父の蔵書はとにかく多すぎて、一冊一冊見ているだけで時間がかかる。
　くわえて、たいていは学術書ばっかりで遠野の家についての資料なんてそう見当たらない。
　見付かったものといえば、親父の日記らしきものだけだった。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“Damn―――I suppose it was too much to hope for something this convenient.”
I sigh and drop into the chair.
Father’s library is enormous, and merely checking every volume takes ages.
Worse, nearly all of them are academic texts, so material on the Tohno family itself is scarce.
All I have found is something that looks like his diary.

lines.japanese:
……親父の見解によると、秋葉が遠野よりの血になってしまったのは俺がいなくなってすぐだという事だった。
　秋葉は生きていくために、人より多く熱量を必要とする。
　その必要とする熱量を十とすると、秋葉が食事で摂取できる熱量は六や七程度のもので、あとの足りない分が秋葉の体に負担をかけさせているらしい。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
According to Father, the Tohno side of Akiha’s blood became dominant soon after I left.
She needs more energy than an ordinary person merely to stay alive.
If the energy her body needs is ten, food provides only six or seven; the constant shortfall places a terrible strain on her.
lines.mao_english:

If the energy her body needs is ten, food provides only six or seven; the constant shortfall places a terrible strain on her.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… The old man looked at it this way: Akiha became one of strong Tohno blood right after I left.
To live, Akiha needs more heat than a normal person.
If you say that the heat Akiha needs is ten, food only gives her six or seven, and the extra heat she needs is the reason for her body's extra burden.

lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:

Father seems to have spent years trying to establish the cause.
At last, in a much later entry, he writes it down.

　なんでも秋葉は自分でもっている十の力のうち、その半分の力しか使っていないというコトだった。
　わかりやすく言うんなら、体の半分しか使っていないのに人並みに動いている、という事らしい。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“Half a life……?”
I don’t understand.
Apparently, Akiha is using only half of the power she possesses.
Put simply, she keeps pace with an ordinary person while functioning with only half her body.

だけど当然、そんな事じゃ人並みに動けるはずがない。
　そのために、秋葉の体は足りない分の力を外界からの熱量で補おうとしている。
　けどそんな行為は人間にはできない、超常の力だ。
故に外界から熱量を必要とすればするほど、人間よりではなく遠野よりの血が活性化するらしい。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
Of course, half a body could never perform like a whole one.
To make up the difference, Akiha’s body tries to draw heat from the world around her.
That is no human faculty, but something supernatural. The more heat she needs from outside herself, the more the Tohno side of her blood awakens at the expense of the human side.

lines.mirrorMoon:

The more she needs heat from her surroundings, the more the Tohno blood awakens as it grows less and less human.

「―――はあ。
原因がわかっても解決方法が載ってないんじゃどうしようもないだろ、バカ親父」

lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
What follows is little more than a record of Akiha’s growth.
I read on for a while, only to discover that none of it helps.
I fling the diary onto the desk.
“―――Hah. What good is a cause without a cure, you useless old bastard?”
Or perhaps even Father failed to find one.
“But if she is only using half her power, where did the other half go?”
If Akiha could use all of her own power, she would not need to steal heat from anyone else.

その戸籍も、名前も、記憶さえも。

I can’t even remember my parents’ faces.
Nor do I want to remember a past that remote.

You would not want leopards or lions loose in your school, would you? When we humans encounter something different from ourselves, something whose animal powers exceed our own, we try to drive it out.
The reason is probably very simple. Demon hunters do not kill such creatures merely because they loathe what is different. Organizations devoted to demon hunting exist because the presence of those creatures within human society threatens human lives.”

lines.maoEnglish:

Without a thought for all the cruelty he had inflicted on you, that shameless command was the last thing he left me before he died.”

　秋葉は口元に手をあてて、言葉を飲みこんだ。

lines.maoEnglish:

“Brother…?”

“Ah――――――”
Akiha covers her mouth and swallows whatever she is about to say.
A long silence passes.
Akiha sadly shakes her head.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Brother―――you are my only brother! Ever since she was little, Akiha has always looked to you!”
“I’m glad to hear that, but you only feel that way because you didn’t know. I could never truly become your brother.”
“I knew from the beginning! I knew you were adopted. I knew you were not my real brother. But I did not care, because from the first time you spoke my name, I―――”
A thud.
Her face wet with tears, Akiha falls against my chest.
“Aki――――ha.”
I place my hands on her slender shoulders.
The heart pounding between us, which one of us does it belong to?
She is so close.
Her body is close enough that I need only close my arms around her―――

Thud.
The sound of her fist striking my chest in helpless frustration.

「兄さんさえ―――兄さんさえいなければ、私はあのままで暮らしていけたのに……！
　私は弱くなって、うそつきになってしまった。
　兄さんに嘘をついて、自分にも嘘をついて。
　ずっと、ずっと兄妹だって嘘をついていれば、それ以外には何も―――何も、いらないって――」
――――胸が痛い。
　そんな些細な嘘を。
そんな小さな嘘を守るために、こんなに泣いてしまうぐらい、秋葉は色々なものに耐えてきたのか。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“If only you―――if only you had never come, I could have gone on living as I was…!
But you made me weak and turned me into a liar.
I lied to you, and I lied to myself.
I thought that if I could keep lying forever, keep pretending we were brother and sister, I would never need anything else―――nothing at all――”
――――My chest hurts.
All of this, just to protect that one tiny lie. Has Akiha endured so much that she could cry like this over it?

“Don’t—don’t say something so ominous…! I told you—you’re still you, Akiha.
Even if—even if your hair never changes back, I don’t care. If you need blood, I’ll give you all you want, and whenever you’re suffering, I want to be beside you.
And besides… this wasn’t nearly enough for me. From now on, I want to love you more and more. So don’t ever say that again. We’re going to be together for the rest of our lives.”
“Brother…”
Akiha says nothing more.
For a little while.
Nothing lies between Akiha and me but the feverish warmth of our bodies.

lines.japanese:
「……ありがとう。
けど、そうなった遠野の者は死ななくてはいけないんです。
　自分が遠野よりの存在になってしまったら速やかに自決する。
……遠野の者はみなそうやって生きてきました。
　完全に変わってしまった者は死にでもしないかぎり元に戻ることができなくなります。
　そうして変貌した肉体には、正常な心が働かない。
私は私自身さえわからなくなって、目に映るものに害をふりまく。
　……恐ろしいのは、そうなってしまったら自決する事さえできなくなってしまうという事なんです」
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“Thank you. But any Tohno who reaches that point has to die.
If the Tohno blood overtakes our humanity, we must take our own lives at once. That is how the Tohno have always lived.
Once the change is complete, nothing but death can return us to what we were.
A normal mind cannot function in such a transformed body. I would lose all sense of who I was and bring harm to everything I saw.
What frightens me is that by then, I may no longer be capable of taking my own life.”

A normal mind cannot function in such a transformed body. I would lose all sense of who I was and bring harm to everything I saw.
What frightens me is that by then, I may no longer be capable of taking my own life.”

Everyone who has changed has gone insane.
I wouldn't even know myself, and I'd cause pain to anything I laid my eyes on.
…… What's scary about it is that you can't even kill yourself when you get like that."

She is unconscious, unable even to resist.

lines.japanese:
「……そうだ。
兄妹であることなんて関係ない。
オレは、誰よりもおまえを愛している」
　シキは秋葉を抱いたまま、倒れた俺の体に近づいてくる。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Yes… It doesn’t matter that we’re brother and sister. I love you more than anyone.”
Still carrying Akiha, SHIKI approaches my fallen body.

lines.japanese:
「今度こそ―――今度こそ二度と帰ってこれないように殺してやるよ志貴。
おまえを生かしているから、秋葉は体に負担をかけているんだからな」
「……体に……ふた、ん……？」
「フン、しらなかったのか。
秋葉はな、あの時に死んだおまえを、自分の命を分け与えることで生かしてやっていたんだ。
　今まで疑問に思わなかったのか？
　胸に大穴を空けられて生きている人間なんているハズがないだろう」
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“This time—this time I’ll kill you so thoroughly you can never come back, Shiki. Keeping you alive is placing a terrible burden on Akiha’s body.”
“A burden…?”
“Hmph, you didn’t know? When you died that day, Akiha kept you alive by giving you part of her own life.
Did you never wonder how you survived? No human being lives after having a gaping hole torn through his chest.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"This time… this time, I'll make sure to kill you so you won't come back, Shiki.
Akiha has this strain on her body because she's keeping you alive."
"…… Strain…… on her, body……?"
"Oh?
You didn't know?
Akiha kept you alive back then by giving you half of her life force.
Haven't you ever wondered about it?
No human can survive with a hole that big in their chest."

lines.japanese:
「八年前のあの日。
　死んでいるおまえを、秋葉は自分の命を分けることで蘇生させたんだよ。
オレがおまえから奪った分の命を、秋葉は自分の命で補っているんだ。
そうでもなければ、おまえが生きている道理なんてないだろうに」
―――命を、分け与えて、いる？
「だから秋葉は自分の体が保てない。
おまえなんかのためにずっと苦しんで、おまえが生きているかぎり、これからも苦しんでいくんだ。
―――それを、今、解放してやる」
　シキが歩いてくる。
　オレの体は動かないまま、意識が遠のいていく。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
“That day, eight years ago, you were dead.
Akiha revived you by sharing her life with you. She has been replacing, with her own life, the life I took from you. Without that, there would be no reason for you to be alive.”
―――She’s… sharing her life with me?
“That is why Akiha can barely sustain her own body. She has suffered all these years for someone like you, and she will go on suffering as long as you remain alive.
―――I’m going to free her now.”
SHIKI comes closer.
My body remains motionless as consciousness recedes.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Eight years ago that day,
Akiha regenerated you by giving you half of her life.
She's supplementing the life I took away from you with part of her own.
There's no way you could have survived if it wasn't for that."
---Sharing… her… life?
"That's why Akiha can't manage her own body.
She's suffered all this time… for you.
As long as you live, she'll keep on suffering.
---I will alleviate that suffering now."
SHIKI walks toward me.
My body will not move.
I can feel myself starting to black out.

lines.japanese:
―――半分の、命。
　……音。
剣が地面に刺さる音。
　罵るような、シキの罵声。
―――親父の手記にあった、秋葉の発作の原因。
「―――遠野くん、いま傷を塞ぎますから、気を確かにしていてください……！」
―――本来なら死んでいた俺の体。
　……体が抱きかかえられる。
　そのまま、どこかに運ばれていく。
lines.label: s374
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Half… a life.
A sound. A sword biting into the earth.
SHIKI’s voice, raised in furious abuse.
―――The cause of Akiha’s attacks, recorded in Father’s journal.
“Tohno, I’m closing the wound now. Stay with me…!”
―――This body of mine, which should have died long ago.
Someone gathers me into their arms.
They carry me away.

lines.mirrorMoon:
---Half of her life.
…… I hear the sound of a sword sticking into the ground.
SHIKI screams.

And takes me somewhere.

……けど、そんな事は、どうでもよかった。

結局は、俺が。
　何から何まで、秋葉を苦しめていた原因だった、のか――――

lines.maoEnglish:
But none of that matters.
―――How could it be? In the end, I was…
The cause of every last thing Akiha had suffered—
